sourceOccurrences.label: From continuum neighbourhoods to sites

sourceOccurrences.label: Strip-coordinate cancellation
sourceOccurrences.note: Möbius normalization, the arcsine map and the harmonic-measure half-angle identity cancel every remaining geometric factor.

sourceOccurrences.note: New consequence of the explicit formula: positive hypergeometric coefficients and their tilted mean prove strict increase and the endpoint equivalents.
